title: A pet's age in whole years
request: Demo request, drafted by the coding agent for the owner to confirm: give every pet one rule for its age in whole years on a given day, so the clinic's screens and letters agree on how old a pet is.
outcome: Anyone who asks how old a pet is on a day gets the same whole number of years, including around birthdays and leap days.
for: Later features that need a pet's age, such as vaccination reminders

rules.text: A pet's age on a day is the number of whole years since its birth date.
A year counts on the birthday itself, not before it.
A pet born on 29 February has its birthday on 1 March in years without a 29 February.
A pet with no birth date has no age.

examples.when: Its age is asked on 2025-02-28, and then on 2025-03-01.

examples.given: A pet with no birth date.
examples.when: Its age is asked on any day.

outOfScope.text: Showing the age on any page: this change adds the rule only.
Ages in months for young animals.

impact.why: Pets are owned by the owner component; the rule belongs on the Pet entity.
